gmcm.debug.warning: Only applies after loading a save. These options are for testing.

gmcm.debug.level.tip: Set Sword Level immediately. Current EXP becomes 0 and remaining SP is recalculated after invested SP.
gmcm.debug.sp.name: Remaining SP
gmcm.debug.sp.tip: Directly set unspent Skill Points for testing.

gmcm.debug.ultimate.name: Force Unlock Ultimates
gmcm.debug.ultimate.tip: For testing Ultimate selection/upgrades. Turning this off also clears the selected Ultimate.

gmcm.debug.all-skills.tip: Sets every skill to 15/15 MASTER and unlocks Secret Arts/Ultimates. Choose branches in the skill tree.

gmcm.debug.unlock-items.tip: Give 1 Secret Art Manual and 1 Drop of Enlightenment.

gmcm.debug.ohgi-start.tip: Ignore level requirements and add the Secret Art unlock quest to the journal.

gmcm.debug.ultimate-start.tip: Ignore level requirements and add the Ultimate unlock quest to the journal.
gmcm.debug.dragon-kills.name: [Quest] Set Dragon Kills to 50
gmcm.debug.dragon-kills.tip: Set the Ultimate quest's dragon hunting progress to 50/50.
gmcm.debug.orbs.name: [Give] 10 Dragon Orbs
gmcm.debug.orbs.tip: Give 10 Dragon Orbs for Ultimate quest testing.
gmcm.debug.ultimate-complete.name: [Quest] Complete Ultimate Quest
gmcm.debug.ultimate-complete.tip: Fill both Ultimate quest objectives and test the completion effect and reward.
